title_original: 수산업협동조합의 부실예방 및 구조개선에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text:
Article 3 (Valuation and Calculation Criteria for Liabilities and Assets)
(1) The valuation and calculation of liabilities and assets as specified in paragraph 3 of Article 2, item (3) shall be based on the actual value of the assets.
(2) The specific details regarding the types of liabilities and assets and their valuation and calculation criteria as stipulated in paragraph (1) shall be determined and announced by the Minister of Maritime Affairs and Fisheries.
